title: A Static for the Colony
author: Ansel Nystrom
blurb: Bram Joubert, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
